title: Classic Smash Burgers
description: Crispy seared beef patties with melted sharp cheddar, pickles, and tangy burger sauce on toasted brioche buns.

instructions.text: Heat a heavy cast iron skillet or flat griddle over high heat until smoking.
Divide ground beef into loose round balls and season generously with kosher salt and black pepper.
Press beef balls hard and flat onto the hot surface, searing for 2 minutes until deep brown crust forms.
Flip, immediately top with cheddar cheese, and cook 1 more minute until cheese melts. Serve on toasted buns.

title: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Tender sliced chicken breast tossed with fresh broccoli florets and savory garlic-ginger soy sauce.

instructions.text: Slice chicken into thin bite-sized strips and toss with 1 tbsp tamari.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Sauté chicken until browned and cooked through (5-6 minutes).
Add minced garlic, minced ginger, and broccoli florets with 2 tbsp water. Cover and steam for 3 minutes.
Stir in remaining tamari, toss well to glaze, and serve hot over rice.

title: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
description: Juicy bone-in chicken thighs roasted alongside baby potatoes and green beans with rosemary and fresh lemon.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly oil a large rimmed baking sheet.
Halve baby potatoes and trim green beans. Toss with olive oil, minced rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Arrange chicken thighs skin-side up surrounded by potatoes and beans. Top chicken with thin lemon slices.
Roast for 30-35 minutes until chicken internal temperature reaches 165°F and potatoes are golden and tender.

title: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Salmon
description: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillets resting in a velvety sun-dried tomato, spinach, and garlic cream sauce.

instructions.text: Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper. Pan-sear in olive oil for 4-5 minutes per side until flaky, then set aside.
In the same pan, sauté minced garlic and sliced sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream and chicken broth; bring to a gentle simmer, then fold in grated parmesan.
Add fresh spinach and simmer until wilted (2 minutes). Return salmon to sauce and spoon sauce over fillets.

title: 15-Minute Vegetarian Pasta Primavera
description: Al dente penne pasta tossed with crisp sautéed asparagus, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and shaved parmesan.

instructions.text: Boil penne pasta in heavily salted water according to package instructions (about 10 minutes). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile, sauté chopped asparagus and diced bell peppers in olive oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and garlic, cooking until tomatoes soften and release their juices.
Toss drained pasta and reserved water with vegetables and parmesan cheese. Garnish with basil.

title: Chickpea & Spinach Coconut Curry
description: Fragrant Indian-inspired curry made with tender chickpeas and fresh spinach simmered in spiced coconut milk.

instructions.text: Sauté finely diced onion, minced garlic, and ginger in olive oil until translucent (5 minutes).
Stir in garam masala, turmeric, and cumin; cook for 1 minute until highly fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, rinsed chickpeas, and coconut milk. Simmer gently uncovered for 15 minutes.
Fold in fresh spinach leaves until wilted. Serve hot with basmati rice or warm naan.

title: Turkey Taco Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
description: Seasoned lean ground turkey over spiced cauliflower rice topped with avocado, black beans, and fresh pico de gallo.

instructions.text: Brown ground turkey in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, breaking apart with a wooden spoon.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water; simmer for 3 minutes until thickened.
In a separate pan, sauté riced cauliflower with olive oil, salt, and lime juice for 4 minutes.
Assemble bowls with cauliflower rice, turkey, black beans, diced avocado, and fresh cilantro.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Scampi with Zoodle Pasta
description: Jumbo shrimp sautéed in rich garlic herb butter served over tender spiralized zucchini noodles.

instructions.text: Melt butter with 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté minced garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley, then remove shrimp from skillet.
Toss zucchini noodles in pan juices for 90 seconds until warm but still crunchy. Serve shrimp over noodles.

title: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chili
description: Hearty vegan chili loaded with roasted sweet potatoes, hearty black beans, sweet corn, and chipotle spices.

instructions.text: Sauté diced onion and bell pepper in olive oil in a large Dutch oven until tender.
Add peeled diced sweet potatoes, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and garlic.
Pour in black beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes until sweet potatoes are fork-tender.

title: Mediterranean Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
description: Crisp romaine, cucumber, kalamata olives, and feta cheese topped with grilled herb-marinated chicken breast.

instructions.text: Season chicken breast with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and olive oil. Grill or pan-sear for 6 minutes per side.
Chop romaine lettuce and dice cucumber and cherry tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Toss salad ingredients in a large bowl with kalamata olives and red wine vinegar dressing.
Slice rested grilled chicken and place atop the salad, finishing with crumbled Greek feta.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling spiced chicken breast strips, rainbow bell peppers, and sweet onions baked together on a single sheet pan.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Slice chicken and bell peppers into even strips.
Toss chicken, peppers, and sliced red onion with olive oil and fajita seasoning on a large baking sheet.
Spread into a single layer and bake for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are slightly charred.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over pan and serve with warm corn tortillas and salsa.

title: Creamy Wild Mushroom Risotto
description: Slow-simmered arborio rice with caramelized cremini and shiitake mushrooms, white wine, and aged parmesan.

instructions.text: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter until golden brown and tender; transfer half to a small bowl for garnish.
In the same pan, soften minced shallots and toast arborio rice for 2 minutes until translucent at edges.
Deglaze with white wine, then add warm vegetable stock one ladle at a time, stirring continuously until absorbed.
Once creamy and al dente (about 20 minutes), stir in butter, grated parmesan, and season with sea salt.

title: Crispy Baked Tofu Buddha Bowl
description: Golden crispy cornstarch-crusted tofu cubes over warm brown rice, roasted broccoli, edamame, and peanut dressing.

instructions.text: Press tofu block for 15 minutes, cut into 1-inch cubes, and toss with cornstarch, salt, and 1 tbsp oil.
Bake tofu on a parchment-lined sheet at 400°F (205°C) for 25 minutes, flipping halfway until golden and crispy.
Whisk peanut butter, warm water, tamari soy sauce, maple syrup, and lime juice into a smooth dressing.
Divide brown rice into bowls, top with crispy tofu, steamed edamame, and drizzle generously with peanut sauce.

title: Quick Korean Beef Bulgogi Bowls
description: Sweet and savory ground beef glazed in soy, brown sugar, garlic, and sesame oil served over jasmine rice with scallions.

instructions.text: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a small prep bowl.
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until no longer pink (6-8 minutes), draining excess fat.
Pour the bulgogi sauce over the meat and simmer for 3 minutes until thickened and glistening.
Spoon glazed beef over steamed jasmine rice and garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallions.

title: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon Caper Butter
description: Delicate wild-caught Pacific cod fillets pan-seared with a bright white wine, caper, and garlic lemon butter sauce.

instructions.text: Pat cod fillets completely dry with paper towels and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a stainless or cast iron skillet over medium-high. Sear cod undisturbed for 3-4 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to low, add butter, minced garlic, capers, and lemon juice around the fillets.
Baste the fish with foaming lemon butter for 1 minute, sprinkle with parsley, and serve immediately.

title: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Zesty shredded chicken breast tossed in Frank's red hot buffalo sauce served in crunchy butter lettuce cups with blue cheese.

instructions.text: Warm shredded chicken in a saucepan over medium-low heat with buffalo sauce until fully coated.
Separate and wash large outer butter lettuce leaves, drying carefully on paper towels.
Scoop warm buffalo chicken into each lettuce cup.
Top with diced crisp celery, blue cheese crumbles, and a light drizzle of ranch dressing.

title: Red Lentil Dahl with Basmati Rice
description: Comforting yellow and red split lentils simmered with coconut milk, cumin, turmeric, and fresh cilantro.

instructions.text: Rinse red lentils under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat oil in a medium saucepan. Toast cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and ginger for 60 seconds until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils, vegetable broth, and turmeric. Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and season with salt. Simmer 5 more minutes until rich and creamy; serve with rice.

title: Sheet Pan Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Apples
description: Herb-rubbed pork tenderloin roasted alongside crisp tart Honeycrisp apples and sweet red onions.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Rub pork tenderloin with Dijon mustard, fresh thyme, salt, and pepper.
Cut apples and red onion into wedges and toss with olive oil, salt, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Place seasoned pork in center of baking sheet surrounded by apple and onion wedges.
Roast for 22-25 minutes until pork internal thermometer reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach and Feta Shakshuka
description: Poached eggs nestled in a spiced, slow-simmered tomato and bell pepper sauce topped with wilted spinach and feta.

instructions.text: Sauté chopped onion and bell pepper in olive oil in a wide cast iron skillet for 5 minutes.
Crush canned tomatoes into the skillet; stir in cumin, smoked paprika, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted. Make 4 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set and yolks remain runny. Top with crumbled feta.

title: Teriyaki Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl
description: Sweet soy-glazed salmon fillet over steamed sticky rice with sliced Persian cucumbers, avocado, and pickled ginger.

instructions.text: Brush salmon generously with teriyaki glaze. Broil or pan-sear for 6-8 minutes until cooked through.
Steam sushi rice and season lightly with rice vinegar and sea salt.
Slice Persian cucumbers and avocado into thin slices.
Assemble bowls with rice, flaked teriyaki salmon, avocado, cucumbers, and nori strips.

title: Beef & Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Vibrant bell pepper halves filled with seasoned lean ground beef, fluffy tri-color quinoa, black beans, and melted pepper jack.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Slice bell peppers lengthwise and scoop out seeds.
Brown beef in a skillet with spices and onions; drain excess fat and stir in cooked quinoa and tomato sauce.
Stuff peppers generously with beef-quinoa mixture and place upright in a baking dish with 1/4 cup water.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes; uncover, top with pepper jack cheese, and bake 10 more minutes until bubbly.

title: Caprese Chicken Bake
description: Seared chicken breasts baked with basil pesto, ripe vine tomatoes, and melted fresh buffalo mozzarella.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Sear chicken in an ovenproof skillet for 3 minutes per side until lightly browned.
Spread a tablespoon of pesto over each breast, top with thick tomato slices and fresh mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes until cheese is golden and melted. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and fresh basil before serving.

title: Sesame Ginger Soba Noodle Bowl
description: Chilled Japanese buckwheat soba noodles tossed with matchstick carrots, purple cabbage, edamame, and sesame ginger vinaigrette.

instructions.text: Cook soba noodles in boiling water for 4-5 minutes. Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water to stop cooking.
In a large bowl, whisk sesame oil, rice vinegar, grated ginger, soy sauce, and a touch of maple syrup.
Add chilled noodles, purple cabbage, carrots, and edamame to the bowl.
Toss well to coat in dressing and finish with toasted sesame seeds and fresh cilantro.

title: Honey Dijon Glazed Pork Chops with Green Beans
description: Seared thick-cut center boneless pork chops glazed in grainy Dijon mustard and pure honey served alongside sautéed green beans.

instructions.text: Whisk Dijon mustard, honey, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper together in a small ramekin.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops for 4 minutes per side until nicely browned.
Pour honey Dijon glaze over pork chops, reduce heat, and baste for 2 minutes until internal temp reaches 145°F.
Steam green beans with garlic and olive oil; serve alongside glazed chops.

title: Mediterranean Baked White Fish with Cherry Tomatoes
description: Flaky white fish baked in parchment with blistered cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, capers, and aromatic oregano.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Place fish fillets in a ceramic baking dish.
Scatter cherry tomatoes, pitted olives, minced garlic, and capers around and over the fish.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork and tomatoes burst.

title: Cauliflower Crust Margherita Pizza
description: Crispy seasoned cauliflower pizza crust topped with crushed San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and aromatic basil.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pre-bake cauliflower crust for 10 minutes until lightly crisp.
Spread pizza sauce evenly across the crust, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Distribute sliced fresh mozzarella and drizzle lightly with extra virgin olive oil.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until cheese is bubbly and edges are golden brown. Top with torn fresh basil.

title: Turkey & Sweet Potato Skillet Hash
description: Savory skillet hash of lean ground turkey, diced caramelized sweet potatoes, baby spinach, and smoked paprika.

instructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium. Sauté diced sweet potatoes and onions for 10 minutes until softened.
Push sweet potatoes to one side; add ground turkey and spices to the skillet and cook until browned.
Stir turkey and sweet potatoes together, cooking for 3 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Fold in baby spinach until wilted, season with sea salt, and serve hot.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice with Edamame
description: Day-old jasmine rice stir-fried with shelled edamame, shredded carrots, green peas, scallions, and toasted sesame oil.

instructions.text: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large wok over high heat. Add minced garlic, peas, carrots, and edamame for 2 minutes.
Add cold cooked jasmine rice, breaking up clumps with a spatula.
Drizzle tamari soy sauce and remaining sesame oil over the rice, tossing constantly for 4 minutes until toasted.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Basil Grilled Shrimp Skewers
description: Skewered jumbo shrimp marinated in fresh lemon zest, cracked black pepper, garlic, and fresh sweet basil.

instructions.text: Thread shrimp onto bamboo skewers (soaked in water for 30 minutes).
Blend olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, basil, salt, and black pepper into a smooth marinade.
Brush marinade liberally onto shrimp skewers and let rest for 10 minutes.
Grill or sear on a grill pan over high heat for 2-3 minutes per side until charred and pink.

title: Butternut Squash and Sage Penne
description: Al dente penne pasta coated in a velvety roasted butternut squash puree with crispy browned butter sage leaves and nutmeg.

instructions.text: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1 cup of pasta water.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat until foaming; fry sage leaves for 1 minute until crisp, then remove leaves.
Add butternut squash puree, nutmeg, salt, and 1/2 cup pasta water to the browned butter, stirring until silky.
Fold pasta and grated parmesan into the sauce, top with crispy sage leaves, and serve warm.

title: Crispy Pan-Seared Lemon Rosemary Salmon
description: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillets with fresh rosemary sprigs, lemon wheels, and a bright garlic white wine pan reduction.

instructions.text: Pat salmon dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Sear salmon skin-side down for 5 minutes.
Flip, add rosemary, lemon, and garlic, basting for 3 minutes.

title: Wild Pacific Halibut with Mediterranean Herb Chimichurri
description: Tender grilled wild Pacific halibut topped with a vibrant homemade parsley, oregano, garlic, and red wine vinegar chimichurri.

instructions.text: Whisk minced parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, and olive oil for chimichurri.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Season halibut with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill 4 minutes per side until opaque; top with chimichurri.

title: Curry Stand Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken breast pieces charred under high heat and simmered in a velvety, aromatic spiced tomato and cream sauce.

instructions.text: Marinate diced chicken in yogurt, garlic, and garam masala for 15 minutes.
Broil chicken chunks on high for 8 minutes until charred.
Simmer onions, ginger, and tomato sauce for 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and broiled chicken, simmering 5 minutes.

title: Slow-Roasted Smoked Texas Brisket Style Beef
description: Tender beef chuck roast slow roasted with coarse black pepper, smoked sea salt, and garlic until melt-in-your-mouth tender.

instructions.text: Rub chuck roast with coarse pepper, smoked paprika, and salt.
Sear on all sides in a Dutch oven.
Add broth and vinegar, cover tightly.
Braise at 300°F for 3.5 hours until probe tender.

title: Skillet Chicken Piccata
description: Thin chicken cutlets pan-fried in olive oil and simmered in a zesty lemon, white wine, butter, and caper sauce.

instructions.text: Dredge cutlets in seasoned flour.
Pan-sear in oil and butter for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Deglaze skillet with broth, lemon juice, and capers.
Swirl in cold butter, coat cutlets, and garnish with parsley.

title: Authentic Mexican Carnitas Bowls
description: Slow-cooked citrus and Mexican oregano seasoned pork shoulder crisped under high heat, served with cilantro lime rice and black beans.

instructions.text: Season pork cubes with cumin, oregano, and salt.
Simmer covered in orange and lime juice for 2 hours.
Shred pork and broil on sheet pan until edges crisp.
Assemble bowls with rice, black beans, and crispy carnitas.

title: Cast Iron Ribeye Steak with Garlic Herb Butter
description: Thick-cut prime ribeye seared with a dark savory crust and basted with melted rosemary, thyme, and roasted garlic compound butter.

instructions.text: Season room-temperature steak liberally with salt and coarse pepper.
Sear in a screaming hot cast iron pan for 3 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, and herbs to pan.
Baste steak continuously with foaming butter for 2 minutes; rest 8 minutes.

title: Spicy Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
description: Minced chicken stir-fried over high wok heat with bird's eye chilies, garlic, sweet dark soy sauce, and fragrant Thai holy basil.

instructions.text: Pound chilies and garlic into coarse paste.
Stir-fry paste in hot wok for 30 seconds.
Add ground chicken, browning thoroughly with sauces.
Stir in Thai basil leaves until wilted; serve over rice with fried egg.

title: Classic Italian Chicken Saltimbocca
description: Tender chicken breasts wrapped with fresh sage leaves and delicate prosciutto di Parma, sautéed in a rich Marsala pan glaze.

instructions.text: Wrap sage leaves and prosciutto onto cutlets.
Pan-sear prosciutto-side down for 3 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook 2 minutes longer.
Deglaze pan with white wine and swirl in butter to sauce.

title: Creamy Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup
description: Rich and hearty Tuscan soup featuring creamy cannellini beans, tender lacinato kale, sweet Italian sausage, and parmesan broth.

instructions.text: Brown sausage in soup pot; remove.
Sauté diced aromatics in rendered fat.
Add beans, broth, and browned sausage, mashing half the beans.
Simmer 15 minutes, then fold in chopped kale and parmesan.

title: Garlic Herb Butter Basted Pork Chops
description: Thick center-cut bone-in pork chops seared golden brown and basted in cast iron with foaming thyme and garlic butter.

instructions.text: Pat pork chops dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat until hot.
Sear chops 4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme, basting for 2 minutes to 145°F.

title: Greek Lemon Herb Chicken Souvlaki Skewers
description: Skewered tender chicken breast marinated in Greek olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, and garlic, served with cooling tzatziki sauce.

instructions.text: Toss cubed chicken with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and garlic; thread onto skewers.
Whisk grated drained cucumber into yogurt with lemon and garlic for tzatziki.
Grill skewers 8-10 minutes over medium-high heat until charred and cooked.
Serve hot with cool cucumber tzatziki.

title: Sheet Pan Chimichurri Flank Steak and Sweet Potatoes
description: Marinated flank steak broiled alongside crispy cubed sweet potatoes and sweet bell peppers, topped with herbaceous green chimichurri.

instructions.text: Roast cubed sweet potatoes with olive oil at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Add seasoned flank steak and bell peppers to sheet pan.
Broil on high for 6-8 minutes until medium-rare.
Slice thinly across grain and drizzle with fresh chimichurri.

title: Creamy Coconut Lime White Fish
description: Flaky wild white cod or mahi mahi poached gently in a fragrant broth of coconut milk, red curry paste, fresh lime, and ginger.

instructions.text: Sauté ginger, garlic, and red curry paste in coconut oil for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and lime zest; bring to gentle simmer.
Poach fish fillets covered for 8 minutes until flaky.
Fold in baby spinach and fresh lime juice before serving.

title: Loaded Turkey Stuffed Zucchini Boats
description: Tender zucchini halves hollowed and stuffed with seasoned lean ground turkey, fire-roasted tomatoes, corn, and melted pepper jack cheese.

instructions.text: Hollow out halved zucchini to create 1/4-inch thick boats.
Brown turkey and diced onion; stir in taco seasoning and tomatoes.
Stuff zucchini boats with turkey and top with cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly and tender.

title: Classic New England Pan-Seared Scallops
description: Jumbo sea scallops pan-seared to caramelized golden perfection, served with garlic herb compound butter and fresh lemon wedges.

instructions.text: Thoroughly pat scallops dry; season with salt and pepper.
Sear in screaming hot pan with oil for 2 minutes without moving.
Flip and add butter and garlic.
Baste for 1 minute only; finish with fresh lemon squeeze.

title: Sheet Pan Greek Meatballs with Lemon Roasted Potatoes
description: Herbaceous beef and lamb meatballs roasted on a single sheet pan with lemon-oregano tossed Yukon gold potato wedges.

instructions.text: Toss potato wedges with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano; roast at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Mix beef, lamb, garlic, mint, and spices into 16 meatballs.
Add meatballs to sheet pan with potatoes.
Roast 18 minutes until meatballs are browned and potatoes crisp.

title: One-Pot Creamy Tomato Basil Tortellini Soup
description: A 20-minute velvety tomato soup packed with tender cheese-stuffed tortellini, fresh baby spinach, and parmesan.

instructions.text: Sauté garlic in olive oil in soup pot for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tortellini and cook 5 minutes until tender.
Stir in heavy cream and baby spinach until spinach wilts.

title: Crispy Skin Duck Breast with Blackberry Balsamic Reduction
description: Pan-seared Moulard duck breast with deeply rendered crispy skin, served with a tart sweet blackberry and aged balsamic reduction.

instructions.text: Score duck skin in diamonds and season with salt.
Place skin-down in cold skillet; render fat on medium-low for 14 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook 3 minutes to medium-rare; rest.
Sauté shallots in 1 tbsp duck fat, reduce balsamic, honey, and blackberries to syrup; spoon over sliced duck.

title: Spicy Honey Sriracha Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets coated in a sticky-sweet sauce of pure honey, sriracha, garlic, and lime juice, broiled until caramelized.

instructions.text: Whisk honey, sriracha, soy sauce, garlic, and lime juice.
Place salmon fillets on foil-lined baking sheet and spoon glaze on top.
Broil on high for 7 minutes until bubbling and glazed.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.

title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Chops
description: Thin bone-in pork chops marinated with fragrant lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, and brown sugar, grilled with charred caramelized edges.

instructions.text: Mince lemongrass and garlic; mix with fish sauce, brown sugar, and soy.
Marinate pork chops for 15 minutes.
Grill on high 3-4 minutes per side until caramelized.
Serve with jasmine rice and sliced cucumbers.

title: Classic Italian Rigatoni Bolognese
description: Slow-simmered rich meat sauce of ground beef, sweet Italian pork, mirepoix, San Marzano tomatoes, and whole milk over al dente rigatoni.

instructions.text: Sauté diced mirepoix in butter for 6 minutes.
Brown beef and pork thoroughly.
Add wine and milk in succession until absorbed; add tomatoes and simmer 45 minutes.
Toss with al dente rigatoni and parmesan.

title: Vegetarian Chickpea Shakshuka with Goat Cheese
description: Eggs poached gently in a spiced sauce of crushed tomatoes, bell peppers, hearty chickpeas, fresh cilantro, and creamy crumbled goat cheese.

instructions.text: Sauté onions and bell peppers in skillet for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, cumin, and chickpeas; simmer 8 minutes.
Make wells and crack in 5 eggs; cover on low for 6 minutes.
Top with crumbled goat cheese and fresh cilantro.

title: Chicken Tinga Tacos with Pickled Red Onions
description: Shredded chicken breast simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce, folded into warm corn tortillas with cotija cheese and quick pickled red onions.

instructions.text: Pickle sliced red onions in lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Blend chipotle adobo, tomatoes, and garlic; simmer with shredded chicken for 6 minutes.
Warm tortillas on hot skillet.
Assemble tacos with chicken, cotija, and pickled onions.

title: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Chicken
description: Pan-seared golden chicken breasts in a decadent sauce of sun-dried tomatoes, tender baby spinach, garlic, and parmesan cream.

instructions.text: Pan-sear seasoned chicken in olive oil 6 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté sun-dried tomatoes and garlic in skillet for 1 minute.
Stir in cream, broth, and parmesan until bubbling and smooth.
Fold in spinach, return chicken to skillet, and spoon sauce over top.

title: Authentic Japanese Chicken Katsu Curry
description: Panko-crusted crispy fried chicken cutlets sliced over steamed sushi rice with rich, savory Japanese golden curry sauce and carrots.

instructions.text: Simmer sliced carrots and onions in water; dissolve curry roux cubes.
Bread chicken cutlets in flour, egg, and panko.
Fry in 1/2-inch hot oil 4 minutes per side until crunchy and golden.
Slice cutlets crosswise and serve over rice with curry.

title: Herb Crusted Baked Halibut with Roasted Asparagus
description: Wild Pacific halibut topped with toasted panko, lemon zest, garlic, and fresh dill, baked alongside tender roasted asparagus spears.

instructions.text: Toss asparagus in olive oil on baking sheet.
Mix panko, melted butter, dill, and lemon zest.
Place halibut fillets on sheet and press herb breadcrumbs on top.
Bake at 400°F for 14 minutes until fish flakes easily.

title: Balsamic Glazed Caprese Stuffed Chicken
description: Chicken breasts pocketed with fresh mozzarella, Roma tomatoes, and basil leaves, baked and glazed with a sweet balsamic syrup.

instructions.text: Cut horizontal pocket in each chicken breast.
Stuff with mozzarella, tomato slices, and basil leaves.
Sear in oven-safe skillet 3 minutes per side.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes to 165°F; drizzle with balsamic glaze.

title: Spicy Peanut Soba Noodles with Crispy Tofu
description: Buckwheat soba noodles tossed in a spicy, savory peanut lime sauce with shredded purple cabbage, edamame, and crispy pan-fried tofu.

instructions.text: Pan-fry pressed tofu cubes in sesame oil until golden crisp.
Boil soba noodles 4 minutes and rinse cold.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime juice, and sriracha with warm water.
Toss noodles, cabbage, edamame, and tofu in peanut dressing.

title: Classic French Beef Bourguignon
description: Chunks of beef chuck braised low and slow in dry red wine and beef stock with bacon lardons, cremini mushrooms, and sweet pearl onions.

instructions.text: Crisp bacon; sear beef cubes in rendered fat until browned.
Deglaze with red wine and beef broth.
Cover and braise in oven at 325°F for 2.5 hours.
Sauté mushrooms and pearl onions; fold in during final 20 minutes.

title: Sheet Pan Lemon Parmesan Crusted Cod
description: Tender Atlantic cod fillets coated in a crunchy crust of freshly grated parmesan, lemon zest, garlic, and herbs, baked with green beans.

instructions.text: Toss green beans in olive oil, salt, and pepper on sheet pan.
Mix parmesan, lemon zest, garlic powder, and melted butter.
Press parmesan mixture onto cod fillets on the sheet pan.
Bake at 400°F for 12-14 minutes until golden crust forms.

title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato and Spinach Gnocchi
description: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in a decadent pan sauce of heavy cream, sun-dried tomatoes, tender spinach, and fresh garlic.

instructions.text: Pan-sear gnocchi in butter for 6 minutes until golden crisp.
Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in cream and parmesan; simmer until thickened.
Fold in baby spinach until wilted; season with black pepper.

title: Mexican Chipotle Beef Barbacoa Bowls
description: Fork-tender chuck roast braised in chipotle adobo, lime, and Mexican spices, served over cilantro brown rice with pinto beans.

instructions.text: Puree chipotles, broth, lime juice, garlic, and cumin.
Sear chuck roast chunks in Dutch oven.
Pour chipotle sauce over beef; braise covered at 300°F for 3 hours.
Shred beef and serve over brown rice with warmed pinto beans.

title: Chimichurri Grilled Chicken Breast
description: Grilled marinated chicken breast topped with authentic fresh Argentine parsley chimichurri.

instructions.text: Whisk parsley, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, and salt for chimichurri.
Pound chicken breasts to even thickness; season with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill 5-6 minutes per side over medium-high heat to 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, slice, and spoon chimichurri over top.

title: Blackened Mahi Mahi with Mango Salsa
description: Cast-iron blackened mahi mahi fillets topped with a sweet and tangy fresh mango avocado salsa.

instructions.text: Dice mango and avocado; toss with lime juice and cilantro.
Coat mahi mahi generously in blackened seasoning.
Sear in screaming hot cast iron pan with 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes per side.
Top blackened fillets with fresh mango avocado salsa.

title: Mediterranean Lamb Kofta Wraps
description: Spiced ground lamb kebabs with cumin, coriander, and mint wrapped in warm flatbread with garlicky tahini sauce.

instructions.text: Mix lamb with minced onion, garlic, mint, cumin, and coriander.
Shape around skewers into oblong koftas.
Grill 8-10 minutes over high heat until browned.
Serve wrapped in warm flatbread with tahini sauce and tomatoes.

title: Sesame Crusted Ahi Tuna Steaks
description: Sashimi-grade ahi tuna coated in sesame seeds, flash seared rare, served with wasabi ginger soy drizzle.

instructions.text: Press ahi tuna steaks firmly into white and black sesame seeds.
Heat sesame oil in cast iron pan over high heat until smoking.
Sear tuna 45-60 seconds per side, keeping center rare.
Slice into thick medallions and serve with soy-wasabi dipping sauce.

title: Classic Beef Stroganoff with Egg Noodles
description: Tender sirloin steak strips and sliced cremini mushrooms in a creamy sour cream and Dijon mustard sauce.

instructions.text: Flash-sear seasoned sirloin strips in butter for 2 minutes; set aside.
Sauté mushrooms and onions until deeply browned.
Deglaze with beef broth and Dijon mustard; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and returned beef; serve over buttered egg noodles.

title: Lemon Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells loaded with whipped whole-milk ricotta, lemon zest, baby spinach, and baked under marinara.

instructions.text: Boil jumbo shells in salted water until al dente.
Mix ricotta, wilted spinach, lemon zest, egg, and parmesan.
Stuff shells generously and arrange in baking dish over marinara sauce.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until bubbly.

title: Thai Green Coconut Curry with Shrimp
description: Succulent shrimp poached in rich Thai green curry broth with bamboo shoots, bell peppers, and fresh Thai basil.

instructions.text: Fry green curry paste in coconut cream for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, bamboo shoots, and bell peppers; simmer 6 minutes.
Add raw peeled shrimp, cooking 3-4 minutes until pink.
Stir in fresh Thai basil leaves and lime juice; serve with jasmine rice.

title: Honey Mustard Sheet Pan Pork Tenderloin
description: Juicy roasted pork tenderloin glazed with Dijon mustard, honey, and rosemary, cooked with baby red potatoes.

instructions.text: Toss halved red potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 400°F for 10 minutes.
Rub pork tenderloin with Dijon, honey, and chopped rosemary.
Place tenderloin on sheet pan with potatoes.
Roast 20 minutes until pork registers 145°F; rest 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Creamy Garlic Tuscan White Fish
description: Delicate white fish fillets simmered in rich garlic cream with sun-dried tomatoes and tender baby kale.

instructions.text: Pan-sear white fish in olive oil 3 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes in pan.
Add heavy cream and simmer until thickened into sauce.
Add baby kale until wilted, return fish to pan, and spoon sauce over top.

title: Authentic Indian Palak Paneer
description: Fresh paneer cheese cubes pan-fried and enveloped in a spiced puree of fresh spinach, garlic, ginger, and garam masala.

instructions.text: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes; shock in ice water and blend smooth.
Pan-fry paneer cubes in ghee or oil until golden.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, and spices in skillet until aromatic.
Add spinach puree and paneer; simmer gently for 5 minutes with a splash of cream.

title: Spicy Pork Dan Dan Noodles
description: Chewy noodles tossed in a fiery Sichuan chili oil and sesame paste sauce, topped with crispy ground pork and scallions.

instructions.text: Crisp ground pork in wok with soy sauce and five-spice powder.
Whisk sesame paste, soy sauce, chili oil, garlic, and broth in bowls.
Cook noodles in boiling water; drain.
Place noodles in bowls with sauce; top with crispy pork, scallions, and roasted peanuts.

title: Spanish Garlic Shrimp (Gambas al Ajillo)
description: Jumbo shrimp sizzling in Spanish olive oil with thinly sliced garlic, dried red chilies, and fresh lemon juice.

instructions.text: Warm olive oil in skillet over medium-low heat with thinly sliced garlic and chilies until golden.
Turn heat to high, add peeled shrimp, and sauté 2 minutes until just pink.
Splash with sherry vinegar and lemon juice; remove from heat.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve sizzling with crusty bread.

title: Sheet Pan Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy bone-in chicken thighs roasted with cracked black pepper, lemon wheels, and tender roasted broccoli florets.

instructions.text: Season chicken thighs on all sides with lemon pepper seasoning and salt.
Toss broccoli florets in olive oil.
Arrange chicken thighs and broccoli with lemon slices on baking sheet.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes until skin is crackling crisp and internal temp is 175°F.

title: Vegetarian Moroccan Chickpea and Sweet Potato Stew
description: Aromatic North African stew of tender sweet potatoes, chickpeas, warming cinnamon, cumin, and dried apricots.

instructions.text: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add cubed sweet potatoes, cinnamon, cumin, turmeric, and ginger.
Add diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer 20 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender; garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Grilled Chimichurri Skirt Steak
description: Charred skirt steak grilled over roaring heat and sliced across the grain, accompanied by piquant green chimichurri.

instructions.text: Whisk finely chopped parsley, minced garlic, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and red pepper flakes.
Season skirt steak with salt and pepper.
Grill over high direct heat for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice thinly against the grain, and top with chimichurri.

title: Creamy Lemon Basil Tagliatelle with Asparagus
description: Fresh ribbons of tagliatelle pasta tossed in silky mascarpone cream with tender asparagus tips and fresh torn basil.

instructions.text: Boil tagliatelle pasta in salted water; add asparagus pieces during the final 2 minutes of cooking.
Whisk mascarpone cheese, lemon juice, lemon zest, and pasta cooking water into a silky sauce.
Drain pasta and toss immediately in the mascarpone sauce.
Fold in fresh torn basil leaves and grated parmesan cheese.

title: Crispy Sesame Ginger Salmon Rice Bowls
description: Oven-baked crispy skin salmon cubes glazed with toasted sesame oil, ginger, and honey over brown rice.

instructions.text: Cut salmon into bite-sized cubes and toss with sesame oil, soy sauce, grated ginger, and honey.
Bake on a parchment-lined sheet at 400°F for 10 minutes until glazed and flaky.
Spoon steamed brown rice into bowls.
Top with warm glazed salmon cubes, sliced avocado, and toasted sesame seeds.

title: Slow Cooker Mexican Chicken Pozole Verde
description: Shredded chicken and white hominy simmered in a zesty tomatillo, poblano pepper, and Mexican oregano green broth.

instructions.text: Broil tomatillos, poblano pepper, and garlic until charred; blend into a smooth green salsa.
Place chicken breasts, drained hominy, chicken broth, and salsa verde in a pot.
Simmer for 30 minutes until chicken is tender; shred chicken with two forks.
Ladle hot pozole into bowls and garnish with shredded cabbage, radishes, and lime.

title: Pan-Roasted Sea Bass with Provençal Ratatouille
description: Crispy-skin sea bass fillets served over a classic French ratatouille of eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, and tomato.

instructions.text: Dice eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers; sauté in olive oil with garlic and thyme for 10 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer on low for 15 minutes until vegetables are meltingly tender.
Score skin of sea bass fillets; sear skin-side down in hot skillet for 4 minutes until crisp.
Flip fish and cook 2 minutes longer; serve over warm vegetable ratatouille.

title: Authentic Thai Red Curry with Duck
description: Rich and creamy red coconut curry packed with tender roasted duck breast, sweet pineapple chunks, and Thai basil.

instructions.text: Sear duck breast skin-down until crisp; slice into medallions.
Fry red curry paste in coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add remaining coconut milk, pineapple chunks, and bamboo shoots; simmer 8 minutes.
Add sliced duck and fresh Thai basil; serve hot with fragrant jasmine rice.

title: One-Skillet Lemon Butter Chicken Thighs and Orzo
description: Crispy browned bone-in chicken thighs roasted atop garlicky lemon and herb infused toasted orzo pasta.

instructions.text: Brown seasoned chicken thighs skin-side down in a skillet for 8 minutes; transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, toast orzo pasta with minced garlic and butter for 2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and fresh lemon juice; arrange chicken thighs back on top.
Bake uncovered at 375°F for 20 minutes until orzo absorbs broth and is creamy.

title: Cast Iron Blackened Salmon with Cauliflower Mash
description: Spicy Cajun blackened salmon fillets paired with a silky roasted garlic and cream cheese cauliflower puree.

instructions.text: Steam cauliflower florets until fork tender; blend with cream cheese, butter, garlic, and salt until smooth.
Coat salmon fillets generously in blackened seasoning.
Sear salmon in a hot cast-iron skillet with 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes per side until charred crust forms.
Serve blackened salmon over hot creamy cauliflower puree.

title: Korean BBQ Short Rib Tacos (Galbi)
description: Thin sweet soy and pear marinated beef short ribs grilled over blazing coals, served in tortillas with kimchi slaw.

instructions.text: Marinate short ribs in soy sauce, grated Asian pear, brown sugar, garlic, and sesame oil.
Grill over high heat 3 minutes per side until deeply caramelized and slightly charred.
Snip ribs into bite-sized pieces with kitchen shears.
Serve in warm corn tortillas topped with chopped kimchi and scallions.

title: Classic French Mushroom Bourguignon
description: Hearty cremini and portobello mushrooms braised in robust Pinot Noir with carrots, pearl onions, and fresh thyme.

instructions.text: Sear thick-cut mushrooms in olive oil until deeply browned.
Sauté diced carrots and tomato paste.
Pour in red wine, broth, and thyme sprigs; simmer for 20 minutes.
Add pearl onions and simmer 10 minutes longer until sauce is glossy and rich.

title: Garlic Herb Roasted Cornish Game Hens
description: Whole individual Cornish game hens butterflied and roasted with rosemary garlic compound butter and baby carrots.

instructions.text: Spatchcock Cornish game hens by removing backbone and flattening breastbone.
Rub herb garlic butter underneath skin and all over surface.
Place hens onto baking sheet over seasoned baby carrots.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes until skin is crisp and thighs reach 165°F.

title: Sheet Pan Harissa Salmon with Roasted Cauliflower
description: North African spicy harissa glazed salmon roasted on one pan with cumin-spiced cauliflower and mint yogurt.

instructions.text: Toss cauliflower florets in olive oil, ground cumin, and salt; roast at 425°F for 10 minutes.
Brush salmon fillets generously with harissa paste and honey.
Place salmon alongside cauliflower on sheet pan.
Roast 12 minutes until salmon flakes easily; serve with cool mint yogurt.

title: Bacon Wrapped Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
description: Pork tenderloin butterflied and filled with baby spinach, feta cheese, and roasted red peppers, wrapped in smoked bacon.

instructions.text: Butterfly pork tenderloin open flat and pound gently with meat mallet.
Layer wilted baby spinach, roasted red peppers, and crumbled feta across pork.
Roll tenderloin tightly into a cylinder and wrap completely with strips of bacon.
Roast at 375°F for 28 minutes until bacon is crisp and pork reaches 145°F.

title: Sheet Pan Sausage, Grapes, and Polenta
description: Sweet Italian sausage links roasted with seedless red grapes, fresh rosemary, and served over creamy mascarpone polenta.

instructions.text: Arrange sausage links and whole grape clusters on baking sheet with rosemary.
Drizzle with olive oil and roast at 400°F for 25 minutes until grapes blister and sausages brown.
Whisk polenta into boiling salted water; cook 15 minutes, then stir in mascarpone cheese.
Serve roasted sausages and sweet jammy grapes over hot creamy polenta.

title: Thai Coconut Green Curry Chicken
description: Tender chicken thighs simmered in a creamy coconut broth with Thai green curry paste, zucchini, and bamboo shoots.

instructions.text: Sauté green curry paste in coconut oil until fragrant.
Add sliced chicken thighs and brown lightly for 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, bamboo shoots, and sliced zucchini; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce and fresh Thai basil; serve over steamed jasmine rice.

title: Crispy Baked Lemon Herb Falafel Bowls
description: Crispy golden baked chickpea falafel patties served over mixed greens with cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and tahini.

instructions.text: Pulse drained chickpeas, fresh parsley, garlic, cumin, and coriander in food processor.
Shape into 12 small patties; brush with olive oil.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway until golden and crispy.
Assemble bowls with greens, diced cucumber, tomatoes, warm falafel, and tahini drizzle.

title: Greek Lemon Orzo Soup with Shredded Chicken
description: Comforting Greek Avgolemono style soup featuring shredded chicken, tender orzo, fresh dill, and egg-lemon emulsion.

instructions.text: Bring chicken broth to a boil and cook orzo pasta for 8 minutes until tender.
Whisk eggs and lemon juice together in a bowl.
Slowly temper egg mixture with 1 cup of hot broth while whisking vigorously.
Pour tempered eggs back into soup off heat, stir in shredded chicken and fresh dill.

title: Pan-Seared Duck Breasts with Port Wine Reduction
description: Crisp-skin Moulard duck breast sliced and spooned with a glossy reduction of ruby port, shallots, and fresh thyme.

instructions.text: Score duck skin and season with salt.
Cook skin-down in cold pan over medium-low heat for 12 minutes to render crisp.
Flip and sear meat side for 3 minutes to medium-rare; rest.
Sauté shallots in pan, deglaze with port wine and broth, reducing until syrupy.

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Ramen
description: Rich ramen broth enriched with creamy peanut butter, chili paste, and garlic, loaded with shredded chicken and bok choy.

instructions.text: Whisk peanut butter, garlic, soy sauce, and chili paste into hot chicken broth.
Simmer baby bok choy and shredded chicken in broth for 3 minutes.
Cook ramen noodles in boiling water; drain.
Divide noodles into bowls, ladle hot spicy peanut broth over top, and garnish with sesame.

title: Seared Scallops over Sweet Corn Puree
description: Caramelized jumbo sea scallops resting on a velvety summer sweet corn and coconut cream reduction with crispy bacon.

instructions.text: Crisp bacon in pan; set aside.
Sauté corn kernels in bacon fat with garlic, add coconut cream, and puree smooth in blender.
Sear dry salted scallops in hot butter for 2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Plate warm corn puree, arrange scallops on top, and scatter with crumbled bacon.

title: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: Center-cut bone-in pork chops rubbed with smoked paprika and roasted with crispy halved Brussels sprouts and bacon.

instructions.text: Toss halved Brussels sprouts and chopped bacon in olive oil.
Season pork chops with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Arrange pork chops and Brussels sprouts on baking sheet.
Roast at 400°F for 22 minutes until pork reaches 145°F and sprouts are caramelized.

title: Tuscan Roasted Garlic Stuffed Chicken
description: Chicken breasts stuffed with garlic herb cheese, roasted bell peppers, and prosciutto, baked to tender perfection.

instructions.text: Cut horizontal pocket in chicken breasts.
Fill with garlic herb spreadable cheese and roasted peppers.
Wrap each breast with prosciutto slices and place in baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 24 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.

title: Thai Red Curry Coconut Mussels
description: Fresh Prince Edward Island mussels steamed open in a fragrant broth of lemongrass, red curry paste, and rich coconut milk.

instructions.text: Sauté red curry paste, minced ginger, and garlic in a wide pot.
Add coconut milk and chicken broth; bring to a rolling boil.
Add cleaned mussels, cover tightly, and steam 4-5 minutes until shells open wide.
Discard any unopened mussels; ladle into large bowls with fresh cilantro.

title: Vegetarian Eggplant Rollatini
description: Grilled thin eggplant slices rolled around rich seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked in San Marzano tomato sauce.

instructions.text: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/4-inch planks; roast at 400°F for 10 minutes until pliable.
Mix ricotta, egg, parmesan, garlic, and fresh basil.
Spread ricotta mixture on eggplant slices and roll up snugly.
Place seam-side down over marinara, top with mozzarella, and bake 20 minutes until bubbly.

title: Spanish Paella with Chicken and Shrimp
description: Saffron scented bomba rice simmered with tender chicken thighs, jumbo shrimp, sweet peas, and smoked paprika.

instructions.text: Sear salted chicken thighs in a paella pan with olive oil; remove.
Sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes; stir in saffron, smoked paprika, and rice.
Pour in warm chicken broth and arrange chicken on top; simmer undisturbed for 15 minutes.
Scatter shrimp and peas across top; cook 8 more minutes until rice forms socarrat crust.

title: Honey Sriracha Glazed Turkey Meatballs
description: Tender oven-baked lean ground turkey meatballs tossed in a sweet and spicy glaze of honey, sriracha, and ginger.

instructions.text: Combine ground turkey, panko, egg, garlic, and green onions; roll into 18 meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Simmer honey, sriracha, soy sauce, and ginger in a skillet until bubbly.
Toss baked meatballs in hot glaze until coated and shiny.

title: Blackened Tilapia Tacos with Cilantro Lime Slaw
description: Quick pan-blackened tilapia fillets wrapped in warm corn tortillas with crunchy shredded cabbage and lime crema.

instructions.text: Coat tilapia fillets generously in blackened spice rub.
Sear in a hot cast-iron skillet with oil for 3 minutes per side until flaky.
Toss shredded cabbage with sour cream, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
Flake fish into warm tortillas and top with cilantro lime slaw.

title: Classic French Coq au Vin Blanc
description: Chicken braised in dry white wine, garlic, and fresh tarragon with cremini mushrooms, shallots, and crème fraîche.

instructions.text: Brown salted chicken thighs in butter in a Dutch oven; remove.
Sauté sliced shallots and cremini mushrooms until browned.
Deglaze with dry white wine and chicken stock; return chicken to pot.
Simmer covered for 25 minutes; stir in crème fraîche and fresh tarragon before serving.
